**The monolithic battery should stream stage receipts or support a resumable manifest.** The cumulative battery exceeded the outer command window without exposing partial evidence, while running the same 12 stages separately gave precise pass/fail receipts. Suggested change: write each stage result atomically as it completes and have `--battery` resume already-passing stages by generator hash, tool version, and phase.

Add an explicit setting selector to `review_witness template`

The native qualification and witness helpers are effective, but the witness recipe workflow would be less error-prone if `template` could accept a qualified case selector plus a small Python callback or JSONPath-derived intermediate, avoiding manual extraction and duplicate failed receipts.

`review_witness template` selects the first nondefault setting; with clockwise, counterclockwise and color-count settings this selected the fixed counterclockwise rule rather than the composed rule. An optional exact `--settings` selector would avoid manual episode-index replacement while preserving the current default; the returned recipe records the corrected qualified case.
